title: What is my aesthetic? Free aesthetic quiz — cv.cm
description: Free aesthetic quiz: answer 12 questions about your room, clothes, music and weekends to find out if you're cottagecore, dark academia, minimalist, Y2K, coastal, grunge, boho or streetwear. No sign-up.
lede: Cottagecore picnics, dark academia libraries or Y2K glitter? Answer 12 questions about your room, your wardrobe and your perfect Saturday to find the aesthetic that fits you.
about: An aesthetic is a whole look and mood that ties together clothes, rooms, music and even hobbies. Many of today's best-known ones spread on Tumblr, Pinterest and TikTok: cottagecore dreams of country life, dark academia romanticizes old libraries and poetry, Y2K brings back the shiny, playful style of the early 2000s, and coastal style borrows the calm of a seaside house. This quiz matches you with one of eight: cottagecore, dark academia, minimalist, Y2K, coastal, grunge, boho and streetwear.

Your result names your aesthetic, with colors, pieces and ideas to try, and shows your scores for all eight, so you can see your runner-up too. Most people mix two or three, and that's the fun part. The quiz was written for cv.cm and every aesthetic appears in the same number of answers.

faq.a: Cottagecore, dark academia, minimalist, Y2K, coastal, grunge, boho and streetwear.

faq.q: Can I have more than one aesthetic?
faq.a: Yes. Your result shows all eight scores; a close second is a good sign you mix styles, like boho with cottagecore or minimalist with streetwear.

faq.q: What is the difference between an aesthetic and a style?
faq.a: A style is usually about clothes. An aesthetic is wider: the colors, places, music, films and hobbies that share the same feeling.

faq.q: Is one result rarer than the others?
faq.a: No. Each aesthetic appears in six answers and in every answer position, so each one is equally likely.

cottagecore.name: Cottagecore
cottagecore.body: You dream of a slower life: baking bread, picking wildflowers and reading in a sunny garden. Your aesthetic is soft and romantic, with floral prints, puff sleeves, linen, wicker and handmade things. Try gingham, pressed flowers, a vintage apron and a long walk in the countryside with a picnic basket.

academia.name: Dark academia
academia.body: You love old libraries, poetry and long conversations about big ideas. Your aesthetic is moody and classic: tweed, turtlenecks, plaid trousers, loafers and leather satchels in brown, black and deep green. Try candlelight, fountain pens, second-hand classics and a rainy afternoon in a museum.

minimalist.name: Minimalist
minimalist.body: You feel best with less: clean lines, calm rooms and a few good things you really use. Your aesthetic is neutral and quiet, with white, black, beige and grey, simple shapes and good materials. Try a capsule wardrobe, one statement plant and a clear desk at the end of every day.

y2k.name: Y2K
y2k.body: You're playful, bold and a little nostalgic for the early 2000s. Your aesthetic is shiny and fun: baby tees, low-rise jeans, butterfly clips, tinted sunglasses, chrome and glitter in pink, baby blue and silver. Try flip phones as accessories, rhinestones and a playlist of early-2000s pop.

coastal.name: Coastal
coastal.body: You love sea air, sunshine and an easy, relaxed life. Your aesthetic is breezy and fresh: linen, stripes, white, sand and every shade of blue, with straw hats and espadrilles. Try a bowl of lemons on the table, sun-faded colors and a long lunch outside whenever the weather allows.

grunge.name: Grunge
grunge.body: You care more about music and honesty than looking polished. Your aesthetic is raw and relaxed: flannel shirts, band tees, ripped jeans, combat boots and layers in black, denim and faded red. Try thrifting, a battered leather jacket and a gig in a small venue.

boho.name: Boho
boho.body: You're a free spirit who loves travel, music and handmade things. Your aesthetic is warm and layered: flowing dresses, fringe, suede, embroidery and turquoise jewelry in terracotta, mustard and cream. Try macramé, plants in every corner and a summer music festival.

streetwear.name: Streetwear
streetwear.body: You're confident, social and always a step ahead of the next trend. Your aesthetic is relaxed and bold: oversized hoodies, cargo pants, graphic tees, caps and the freshest sneakers. Try mixing one limited piece with basics, a skate park on the weekend and following your favorite brands' drops.
